ghcp_training_day_1.database module¶

DuckDB-backed persistence layer for tickets (TicketRepository).

exception ghcp_training_day_1.database.TicketNotFoundError¶

Bases: LookupError

Raised when a ticket ID does not exist in the tickets table.

class ghcp_training_day_1.database.TicketRepository(database_path: str | Path = 'data/tickets.duckdb')¶

Bases: object

Thread-safe DuckDB access layer for creating, querying, and mutating tickets.

A single connection is shared across calls and guarded by a lock, since DuckDB connections are not safe for concurrent use from multiple threads.

close() → None¶

Close the underlying DuckDB connection.

create(ticket: TicketCreate) → Ticket¶

Insert a new ticket with status open and return the persisted Ticket.

Parameters:

ticket – Validated fields for the new ticket.

Returns:

The newly created ticket, including its generated id and timestamps.

delete(ticket_id: int) → None¶

Delete a ticket by ID.

Parameters:

ticket_id – The ticket’s primary key.

Raises:

TicketNotFoundError – If no ticket with ticket_id exists.

get(ticket_id: int) → Ticket¶

Fetch a single ticket by ID.

Parameters:

ticket_id – The ticket’s primary key.

Returns:

The matching Ticket.

Raises:

TicketNotFoundError – If no ticket with ticket_id exists.

list(filters: TicketFilters | None = None) → list[Ticket]¶

Return tickets matching filters, ordered by created_at then id (ascending).

Parameters:

filters – Optional status/priority/search criteria. When omitted, all tickets are returned.

Returns:

The matching tickets in creation order.

seed_defaults() → None¶

Insert three sample tickets if the tickets table is currently empty.

No-op when the table already has at least one row, so it is safe to call on every application startup.

update(ticket_id: int, update: TicketUpdate) → Ticket¶

Apply a partial update to a ticket and refresh its updated_at timestamp.

Only fields explicitly set on update are changed; unset fields are left untouched. If update has no set fields, the ticket is returned unchanged (still validating that it exists).

Parameters:

  • ticket_id – The ticket’s primary key.

  • update – Partial field values to apply.

Returns:

The ticket after the update is applied.

Raises:

TicketNotFoundError – If no ticket with ticket_id exists.

ghcp_training_day_1.main module¶

FastAPI + NiceGUI application entry point for the ticketing system.

ghcp_training_day_1.main.create_app(database_path: str | None = None, seed: bool = True) → FastAPI¶

Build the FastAPI app: repository, REST API router, NiceGUI dashboard, and lifespan.

Parameters:

  • database_path – DuckDB file path, or “:memory:”. Defaults to the TICKET_DB_PATH env var, then “data/tickets.duckdb”.

  • seed – Whether to insert sample tickets if the database is empty.

Returns:

A configured FastAPI application with the ticket API mounted at /api and the NiceGUI dashboard mounted at /.
